newsitem.title: USA: NYH jet diffs talked higher in lackluster trade.
newsitem.headline: NYH jet diffs talked higher in lackluster trade.

text.p: New York Harbor (NYH) jet fuel differentials inched higher Friday, though traders said no barrels appeared to change hands in the quiet conditions.
Many players were absent following the Christmas holiday on Wednesday, and those in the market said the lack of liquidity made it difficult to make trades.
NYH aviation-grade jet fuel was talked between 2.00 and 2.50 cents over the NYMEX, an increase of 0.25 to 0.50 cent on the day.
Outright jet fuel prices moved higher, boosted by the bounce of about 0.50 cent in the futures' price.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1626
